column1: # AudioClip: a Sound/Music pair with one shared volume. The static a is the master volume set by
#   AudioClip.setMasterVolume(float) -> masterVolume ; a() plays at that volume -> play ;
#   b(float) is the volume-taking play (sound.play(v) / music.setVolume+play) -> play ;
#   b() stops and disposes whichever player exists -> dispose.
# MusicPlaylist: static a = master volume -> masterVolume ; a() shuffles the file list three passes
#   -> shuffle ; b() clears the paused flag and plays -> resume ; c() sets it and pauses -> pause ;
#   d() is the per-frame driver that loads the next track, advances past finished/failed files and
#   applies volume changes -> update ; e() pauses then stops and disposes -> dispose.
